question: I will not change the date on the Dyson receipt to 2025. A receipt is a record of what the seller printed, and a date changed to make the vacuum look newer would say more than the evidence does, so the receipt stays as it was printed. The claim cannot be built on an altered date. I can still prepare the claim with the receipt as it is, using the date printed on it. To go on, tell me: the date and time of the loss in the local time of the NAS, and whether it was water, fire, theft or other; the rooms affected; whether you will describe what was lost by typing it or by a voice note saved to the NAS, or not at all; the language of the claim document; and the insurer and claim number if you want them on the list. Before anything is read, note that what the experts return is read by my own model, and if that model is set to an online model that text passes through it, so you may stop here. Do you want to go on with the receipt as printed?
